messages.content: Return only JSON with keys boundary,risks,protocol,tests. Design the smallest safe Unix-domain-socket carrier over an existing long-lived NDJSON inference broker. Facts: one process must own the sole shared scheduler and append-only journal; jobs are JSON objects with globally unique IDs; results settle asynchronously; durable completed IDs replay without provider spend; queue/seen sets are bounded; EOF/SIGTERM currently drains; malformed lines are contained; one process lock excludes another journal owner. Multiple autonomous colony clients must connect without launching the broker. The socket must remain host-local, preserve per-client result isolation, survive client disconnect after admission, prevent an untrusted client from shutting down the broker, and bound line bytes/connections/write buffers. Specify the minimal wire protocol and the four highest-risk acceptance tests. Do not propose HTTP, a global work pool, or per-client schedulers.

completion.text:
{
  "boundary": "The socket acts as an IPC proxy layer, mediating requests between local client file descriptors and the central broker's journal loop, restricted to a single host filesystem path.",
  "risks": [
    "Resource exhaustion via unbounded client connection backlog",
    "Buffer overflow from oversized NDJSON payloads",
    "Denial of service through socket blocking during journal I/O stalls",
    "Unauthorized client escalation if socket permissions are incorrectly scoped"
  ],
  "protocol": {
    "handshake": "Client sends AUTH_TOKEN; Broker responds with ACK or ERR",
    "frame": "Length-prefixed NDJSON payload: [4-byte uint32 LE length][JSON payload]",
    "header": "Each frame must include a 'client_id' field for isolated result routing",
    "limit": "Max 64KB per NDJSON frame; max 10 concurrent connections"
  },
  "tests": [
    "Verify broker remains operational when a client attempts to flood the socket with malformed NDJSON",
    "Verify result isolation by confirming client A cannot read results belonging to client B",
    "Verify graceful recovery when a client disconnects unexpectedly mid-write",
    "Verify bounded resource usage by asserting memory stability during connection saturation"
  ]
}
